290:44.en: 「I've had enough! Of days like these!」

290:87.en: 「Stay out of my way!\nDo you want to die that badly?!」

290:134.en: 「I hate it...!\nThe hatred just keeps welling up!」

290:187.en: 「Aaah! My head's about to split open!」

290:306.en: 「To get rid of this frustration,\nall I can do is destroy!」

290:361.en: 「Just let me do what I want!\nI've had enough!」

290:451.en: 「I don't care! Not me, not the world!」

290:494.en: 「What is this?!\nMy head's throbbing deep inside!」

300:5877.en: 「I don't want the world you'd create.」

300:9114.en: 「Those who steal freedom\nwill face me and $$ビッグオー$$!」

300:9169.en: 「The time for talks is past...!\nYou brought this force on yourself!」

300:9234.en: 「Power is good or evil depending\non its user. I feel that keenly...!」

300:9332.en: 「It seems even Death hates you,\n$$アサキム$$...!」

300:9442.en: 「You're unworthy of the name of god!」

300:9481.en: 「No one in this world\nknows everything! Nor is one needed!」

300:9550.en: 「In short, the audience doesn't\nwant the ending you've written!」

300:11714.en: 「Wait, $$ビッグオー$$. This is my job.」

302:1171.en: 「Whatever you're plotting...\nI can't let you go any further!」

302:1236.en: 「We don't know what they're after,\nso we've got to fight!」

302:1285.en: 「I'm counting on you, $$刹那$$!\nWe'll hold out over here!」

302:1714.en: 「I won't have a machine deciding...\nour future for us!」

302:5340.en: 「I'm counting on you, $$刹那$$...!\nWe're about at our limit here...!」

302:3810.en: 「No way I'm grappling with you lot!」

302:3851.en: 「I can't use $$脳量子波$$,\nbut I can at least be a decoy!」

302:5615.en: 「All right. $$ガンダムサバーニャ$$, $$ロックオン・ストラトス$$! Taking the shot!」

306:11427.en: 「We'll leave peacemaking to the pros,\nand as for us...!」

306:11513.en: 「Things should change soon enough,\nso this is where we hold on...!」

306:11004.en: 「I leave the future to you, $$ダンクーガ$$.」

306:11070.en: 「All of $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ rests with you!」

345:9779.en: 「If they want a fight, we'll have to!」

345:9882.en: 「Why won't you\naccept the way things are?!」

345:9931.en: 「I'll never let you pull off\na self-serving repair!」

345:10190.en: 「If you've got a $$スフィア$$,\nwe've got guts!」

345:10251.en: 「$$スフィア$$ or not, I won't back down!」

345:10290.en: 「I feel for you! But some things\nin this world must never be done!」

345:10363.en: 「I'll figure out what to do later!\nRight now, I'm stopping you!」

345:10422.en: 「Here I come, fake god!\nEven salarymen can protect space!」

345:10487.en: 「I'll hit you with all my salaryman\ngrit, pride, and hope for peace!」

345:12129.en: 「$$墨田$$ and $$里香$$ will scold me...」

g290.basis: Unidentified woman (私, rough あんた/どきな); 12 rage lines in the 'could not retaliate' slot plus 'What was I doing...' when shot down = someone driven berserk by hatred/headache. No story or Jigoku match found (Esther uses あたし, not 私).

g300.basis: Agrees with Jigoku: negotiator talk, Big O, Asakim/Sphere/Angel special-opponent lines. 300:5877 sits in R. Dorothy's run (5680-6316), so that one row is $$Ｒ．ドロシー・ウェインライト$$.

g302.basis: Agrees with Jigoku (Lyle as Lockon): Gundam Zabanya sortie call with his name, ELS / Setsuna dialogue lines, rough ぜ/ねえ speech.

g306.basis: Agrees with Jigoku for the Aoi rows (team-wide block; 私達, わよ, Absolute Hurricane/Plasma weapon slots). 306:10923-11144 (weapon slot 8 cut-in) are a male Dragon's Hive commander (君達, 託す, 'All of Dragon's Hive'), not Aoi; no token for him in the glossary.

g311.basis: Jigoku had none. 311:0 shares its audio cue (7012691) with 337:5475, which sits in Uchuta's lines of the Zambot set; block 323 (same text) shares Keiko's cue (= 337:698). Zambot 3 'Combination In' call; wording matched to 337:698.

g340.basis: Agrees with Jigoku's correction: generic Sleeves Personal Guard grunt (親衛隊/大尉/大佐 lines); not Kira.

g345.basis: Agrees with Jigoku: salaryman/Dai-Guard lines, names Yokozawa, Sumita, Rika-chan.

uncertain: g290 speaker not identified: a woman (私, rough どきな/あんた) raging berserk in 12 'could not retaliate' slots, 'What was I doing...' when shot down. No story or Jigoku match; Esther ruled out (always あたし). 290:134 憎い has no object: rendered 'I hate it...!'.

g306 is a team-wide block. 306:10923-11144 (weapon slot 8, with Aoi's 'Plasma!' line 5779) are a male Dragon's Hive commander, probably Dr. Hazuki (no glossary entry, not named in the lines). 306:10207/10238 Absolute Hurricane (weapon slot 7) sit in Sakuya's run, so the shouter may be Sakuya, not Aoi; the English doesn't depend on who.
300:5877 is R. Dorothy (her run, 5680-6316), not Roger: 'I don't want the world you'd create.' Shortened from 'don't want to SEE the world'.
311:0 'Combination, in!' copied from the existing 337:698 rendering of the same Zambot call (same audio family) for consistency; plain 'Combination In!' would also work.
345:10754/10775 振動地雷 coined as 'Vibration Mine' (no English in voice, story or UI). 10775 振動地雷なら…！ = 'The Vibration Mine should...!' (if-clause, rest implied).
345:12129 kept as 37 chars ('$$墨田$$ and $$里香$$ will scold me...') so both names stay. Story uses '$$里香$$-chan'.
302:5615 sortie cut-in has no break in the Japanese and runs 59 chars with the two full names. 狙い撃つぜ = 'Taking the shot!' as in g302:1893. Left LONG.
302:1340 刹那が対話を成功させるまで = 'Hold till $$刹那$$'s dialogue works!' (imperative to the team, 辛抱だ).
300:9804 / 9442: Roger addresses the Angels. 御使い token used singular; 神の名 = 'the name of god'.
345:10139 みんな read as 'everyone/people' (subject), not an address to allies.

names.振動地雷: Vibration Mine (Dai-Guard weapon, coined; plain text, no token)
names.アブソリュートハリケーン: Absolute Hurricane (Max God attack, plain text)
